text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD alert — GPU autoscale warning for cluster/prod-gpu-pool. queue_growth > 95% for inference queue, HPA not increasing replicas. Threshold crossed at 2024-04-02T14:12:13Z

pagerduty-bot: @alex pagerduty: you have been paged for incident P12345 (severity: high)

alex: i'm on it, joining now. can someone paste HPA status?

jess: taking handoff in 2m, dropping notes here. oncall for next 30m -> jess (handoff) :wave:

sam: fyi customers are seeing throttled responses and some 500s. CS ticket opened (CS-7890).

eng-sre: early signal looks like custom metrics pipeline lag. prom-adapter queue length jumped, metrics-server shows high scrape-latency. HPA didn't get metric updates for ~8m.

maria: logs from prometheus-adapter pod show repeated timeouts to Prometheus: 
```
2024-04-02T14:10:21Z warn adapter: post custom metrics failed: 504 Gateway Timeout (upstream)
2024-04-02T14:10:21Z info adapter: queue_size=812 backlog_ms=470000
```

kevin: kubectl output (from eng-runtime):
```
$ kubectl get hpa gpu-inference-hpa -n prod -o wide
NAME                 REFERENCE                     TARGETS   MINPODS MAXPODS REPLICAS AGE
gpu-inference-hpa    Deployment/inference-worker   0%/80%    2       50      2        5h
```
HPA is stuck at 2 replicas. metrics for custom/gpu_utilization missing.

alex: trying manual scale to stop immediate customer impact. patching deployment replicas -> 8
```
kubectl patch deployment inference-worker -n prod --type merge -p '{"spec": {"replicas": 8}}'
```

sam: confirmed replicas -> 8, queue drained ~40% in next 60s, latency improved for some requests. customers still impacted intermittently. :thumbsup:

product-support: notifying top customers, escalation message sent. CS posted status: "degraded performance" on status.redwood.ai

eng-runtime: can we restart prometheus-adapter to clear backlog? risk: short gap in metrics -> HPA may undershoot but manual scaling covers immediate needs.

jess: agreed. take controlled restart of adapter, scale adapter replicas to 3 first.

maria: running commands: 
```
kubectl scale deployment prometheus-adapter -n monitoring --replicas=3
kubectl rollout restart deployment prometheus-adapter -n monitoring
```

kevin: logs after restart show adapter reconnect and backlog processing: 
```
2024-04-02T14:16:02Z info adapter: processing backlog=0 queue_size=12
2024-04-02T14:16:04Z info adapter: pushed 200 metrics to k8s custom metrics API
```

eng-sre: HPA now receiving metrics, observed custom/gpu_utilization ~65% and HPA created additional scale events. HPA replica count moved to 10 over next 2m.

alex: rolling back manual scale to let HPA manage once stable. patching replicas -> 4 (min needed).
```
kubectl patch deployment inference-worker -n prod --type merge -p '{"spec": {"replicas": 4}}'
```

pagerduty-bot: @jess acknowledged the incident.

product-support: status page updated: partial mitigation in place, customers with heavy workloads might still see intermittent delays.

maria: root cause timeline notes: Prometheus scrape latencies spiked due to a large influx of ephemeral targets (batch job churn) causing adapter queue to grow. adapter hit internal queue limit and started failing with 504s to upstream Prometheus. HPA relies on adapter-delivered custom metrics, so scaling delayed until backlog drained.

sam: immediate mitigations done: manual scale, adapter scale+restart, temp increase of HPA maxPods from 50->80 to give room for rapid scale if needed.

eng-runtime: command used: 
```
kubectl patch hpa gpu-inference-hpa -n prod -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":80}}'
```

jess: requesting postmortem. assign owners: eng-sre (investigate adapter queue behavior), eng-runtime (autoscale tuning + HPA defaults), eng-ml (workload shaping), infra (prometheus scrape stability).

kevin: follow-ups:
- increase prometheus-adapter replicas to 3 permanently and add liveness probe improvements
- add circuit-breaker / backpressure so adapter rejects new work earlier rather than timeouts
- add alert if custom metrics delta > 2m
- consider using pushgateway for ephemeral batch jobs to avoid scrape spikes

product-support: CS will follow up with affected customers with timeline and mitigation steps.

alex: final check: production latency back to normal 95th within SLOs after 8m of mitigation. marking incident P12345 as mitigated — will file full incident report.

incident-bot: incident status updated to "mitigated". runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/autoscale-metrics-lag

jess: closing handoff. will drive postmortem doc and timeline. thanks all. :heart:

customer-success: please add entry for customer CS-7890 in postmortem with timeline and follow-ups.

eng-sre: leaving notes for root cause: prometheus scrape spike -> adapter queue starved -> HPA metric starvation -> delayed autoscale -> queue growth -> temporary GPU exhaustion risk. follow-ups tracked in ticket INFRA-3212.

sam: any retrospective action items, put into sprint planning for next cycle.

kevin: bumping priority for adapter hardening.

alex: standby to reopen if anything regresses.

-- end of thread --
